nodes.label: Legacy correctAnswer Format Support
nodes.rationale: The system auto-detects and accepts an old CSV format where correctAnswer held actual option text (e.g. 'Python,Java') instead of option numbers (e.g. '1,2'), preserving backward compatibility for previously-prepared CSV files instead of forcing all existing content to be rewritten.
